Why Each Item on This List Matters

Each item on the list matters because it highlights a specific challenge or opportunity in the current payment landscape for digital creators. For instance, the fact that NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies matters because it gives creators flexibility in choosing which currencies to accept. Similarly, the fact that Cloudflare Pages offers free hosting matters because it reduces the overhead costs for creators, allowing them to allocate more resources to marketing and product development. The Ones Most Creators Get Wrong

Many creators get wrong the importance of owning their infrastructure and data. They often rely on third-party platforms that take a significant cut of their earnings and dictate how they can interact with their customers. By not controlling their own infrastructure, creators are at the mercy of these platforms, which can change their terms of service or fees at any time. This lack of control can lead to significant losses if the platform decides to restrict or terminate the creator's account. In contrast, using sovereign commerce infrastructure like the solutions offered by COREMERCH ensures that creators retain full ownership and control over their online stores and customer data.
